contact.basis: Unchanged LINZ ground at the portico approach. The historical basement and terrace meet the sampled original slope.

attribution: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, national 1m DEM and DSM, CC BY 4.0
method: Unaltered source pixels cropped from LINZ BH34 and BJ34 and sampled bilinearly in the native hotel frame with no ground flattening. The separate DSM samples constrain roof heights.
